name: Competitor brief
description: Competitor research from public sources and, where granted, the owner's own documents such as sales notes.
instructions: Cover each competitor's positioning, published pricing, documented limits and notable recent changes. Where the owner's documents mention a competitor (sales notes, lost-deal reviews), include those observations and label them as internal. Separate what the competitor states about itself from what others say about it. Note the date of each source.
changelog: Adds the owner's local documents as a source of internal observations.

checks: reads granted local documents; no write access
